answer_1.quote: We incorporate diverse and contextually rich augmentations in TAL to achieve more discriminative and controlled representations. We showcase this by using large vision-language models such as GPT-4 and DALL-E to generate textual and image augmentations, respectively.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates textual descriptions and images as augmentations for zero-shot temporal action localization using GPT-4 and DALL-E.
